contract_control.scope: A separate local synthetic control accepted unsigned Windows, rejected a signed claim, rejected a missing installer and rejected a missing SQLite worker. The full test_release_platforms suite had two unrelated Linux fixture errors concerning absent formal companion evidence; it was not green.

installer_control.scope: Synthetic install, collision, checksum, embedded installer, seven executable roles, unexpected-file protection, uninstall and traversal checks; installer bytes match this cohort.

note: The Windows release is intentionally unsigned. Native product journey, exact release-source build, installation, minimum-OS and desktop acceptance remain required.

package_control.scope: Synthetic x64 PE files, native Windows candidate packaging and source-bound release-contract validation. Windows package/build scripts and release_contract.py match the files in this cohort. The tested platform profile predates the stricter seven-executable requirement.
